rejected_summary.reason: Near-zero ESM-1v plausibility and phosphorylation-site disruption in the acidic N-terminal region likely harms transactivation.
Proline insertion in the essential helical core region has near-zero plausibility and high risk of disrupting the transactivation domain.
Loss of the conserved aromatic Phe in the core domain is poorly supported (0.0001) and likely destabilizing to TAR interaction.
Weakening a key arginine in the RKKRR core with K is riskier than K51R and has no PLM support.
Cysteine-region-adjacent Thr to Ala offers no transactivation benefit and near-zero model support.

reconsideration_rules: reconsider requires trigger_evidence_ids with NEW evidence; without it the action is rejected.
